## Pull request overview

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no new comments.




<details>
<summary>Suppressed comments (3)</summary>

**docs/tooling/copilot-review-gate.md:258**
* This rung claims it needs no checkout, but both `gh run list` and `gh run rerun` infer the repo from the current directory unless `-R owner/repo` is provided. As written, it won’t work outside a checkout and can act on the wrong repo inside a different checkout.
```
   gh run list --workflow=copilot-review-gate.yml --limit 20 \
     --json databaseId,headSha,event,createdAt \
     --jq '.[]|select(.headSha|startswith("<head-sha>"))|"\(.databaseId) \(.event) \(.createdAt)"'
   gh run rerun <id>
```
**docs/tooling/copilot-review-gate.md:204**
* `gh run list` defaults to the repository inferred from the current working directory’s git remote, so this command isn’t actually checkout-free (it fails outside a repo, and can target the wrong repo inside a different checkout). Add `-R luciocabrera/vite-react-compiler` (or document the checkout requirement) so the “check rather than assume” step is runnable from anywhere.

This issue also appears on line 255 of the same file.
```
gh run list --workflow=review-gate-reconcile.yml --limit 5
```
**.github/workflows/copilot-review-gate.yml:92**
* The comment says the default ref for `pull_request_review` is the pull request’s branch, but for PR-scoped events GitHub Actions’ `${{ github.ref }}` is typically the merge ref (`refs/pull/<n>/merge`), not the head branch ref. Since this comment is used to justify checkout behavior, it should be precise about merge ref vs head branch, while still keeping the key correction (“not the default branch”) that you measured.
```
      # `pull_request_review` it is the PULL REQUEST'S OWN BRANCH; for
      # `workflow_dispatch` it is the ref the dispatch named. Each of those
      # checks out the script that matches the YAML that ran. Nothing here reads
      # the working tree beyond that script — the head SHA comes from the API,
```
</details>

## Pull request overview Adds a repo-level “published manifest audit” that compares what’s *actually on the npm registry* for each published `@lcabrera/*` version vs what the repo expects consumers to be able to install/load. This complements `publish:verify` (which validates the pnpm-packed tarball the repo would produce) by detecting drift caused by out-of-band publishes or registry state. **Changes:** - Introduces `vp run release:audit` (`scripts/release-audit.mjs`) plus a pure audit engine (`scripts/lib/release-audit.mjs`) to validate `exports` targets and dependency ranges from registry packuments. - Extracts and shares release tooling primitives: registry packument fetch (`scripts/lib/registry-packument.mjs`) and publishable workspace discovery (`scripts/lib/publishable-workspaces.mjs`), then refactors `release-publish-plan.mjs` to use them. - Adds a scheduled GitHub Action (`.github/workflows/release-audit.yml`) that runs daily and files/updates a single tracking issue when drift is detected, plus docs/ADR coverage. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | scripts/release-publish-plan.mjs | Refactors release planning to use shared workspace discovery and shared registry packument fetch. | | scripts/release-audit.mjs | New CLI entrypoint for auditing published manifests against the registry (effectful runner + reporting). | | scripts/lib/release-audit.mjs | New pure audit engine: flattens `exports`, detects `./src/` targets (when applicable), flags `catalog:`/`workspace:` ranges, renders report. | | scripts/lib/release-audit.test.mjs | Unit tests covering export flattening, protocol detection, version/tag/deprecation semantics, and “resolved nothing” guard. | | scripts/lib/registry-packument.mjs | New shared registry client with fail-closed semantics (404 → undefined, others throw) and `full` vs abbreviated packument support. | | scripts/lib/registry-packument.test.mjs | Unit tests asserting Accept header behavior and failure semantics. | | scripts/lib/publishable-workspaces.mjs | New shared filesystem scan for non-private workspaces eligible to reach the registry. | | .github/workflows/release-audit.yml | New scheduled workflow running the audit and creating/updating a tracking issue on failure. | | package.json | Adds the root script entry for `release:audit`. | | docs/decisions/ADR-077-audit-every-published-version-and-report-rather-than-block.md | Documents decisions: audit every published version; report (don’t gate PRs); deprecation discharge; fail when resolved nothing. | | COMMANDS.md | Documents `release:audit` usage, behavior, and why it’s scheduled (not per-PR). | | docs/coordination/tasks/registry-manifest-audit.md | Adds the coordination claim/task record for this work. |
